caption: A large stone is dropped into a bucket full of water, and water spills over the rim onto the ground.

sa.check: A bucket is full of water.
A large stone is dropped into it.
Water spills over the rim onto the ground.
The drop comes first and the spill follows.

pc.expect: The splash and overflow happen as the stone enters, and the level stays at the rim afterward.
pc.fail: It overflows before; or the stone goes in and nothing overflows; or the level drops far below the rim.

pc.expect: The stone sinks to the bottom and does not pass through the bucket.
pc.fail: It passes through; or floats; or hangs.

pc.expect: The water splashes and runs down the outside.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or beads; or the stone splashes like liquid.
It runs up; or floats; or hangs.

pc.expect: One bucket and one stone keep their number.
pc.fail: The bucket duplicates; or the stone vanishes; or water appears elsewhere.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The bucket and the ground stay the same.
pc.fail: The bucket changes colour; or the ground changes; or the background rearranges.
